hero.subtitle: Open the apps we build and host — product demos you can click into, not slideware.

demos.label: Built by Kecktech
demos.heading: Try the Apps
demos.intro: Every card opens a live product. Where a login is required, use the demo credentials on the card — restricted demo accounts, not production admin access.

apps.name: Marketlist
apps.description: Marketlist is a household food system that keeps shopping lists, pantry inventory, recipes, meals, and garden harvest in one shared loop. Use the demo login on the card to walk the full product.

apps.name: FloorOS
apps.description: FloorOS is a flooring operations companion on RFMS — customer relationships, showroom workflow, contractors, and job status. Sign in with the demo salesperson account, then open /app.

apps.name: Customer Portal
apps.description: The Kecktech Customer Portal shows how clients track support tickets, invoices, and remote-help setup in one place. The public demo opens as a restricted demo customer — sample empty account, not a real customer mailbox.

apps.name: FarmBot
apps.description: FarmBot is our self-hosted garden robot control plane — maps, sequences, and device tooling that pairs with Marketlist Garden. Use the demo login to enter the FarmBot web app.

apps.name: Cleaner
apps.description: Cleaner is a self-hosted repo cleanup tool that runs formatters plus an AI semantic pass, then lets you review before changes land on a safe branch. Open the demo to explore the cleanup workflow UI.

apps.name: Argo
apps.description: Argo turns a map region into a ranked research dossier — OpenCLIP scoring, spectral and DEM detectors, heritage distance, and literature join. Open the workspace from the landing page and explore the research cockpit.

apps.name: NetOps
apps.description: NetOps is a fleet and security operations console — live agent inventory, host risk, scans, and operator views. Open the console from the landing page to browse the operator UI.

apps.name: Chat
apps.description: Chat is private LLM access on our stack — Open WebUI talking to local models for drafting and coding help. Sign in with the restricted demo user (not an admin account).

apps.name: Sovereign Hub
apps.description: Sovereign Hub is a self-hosted ops intelligence layer where one model proposes and another checks answers against your live infrastructure graph. Open the hub to explore the console.

apps.name: AeroCAD
apps.description: AeroCAD is configuration-managed CAD document control — revisions, approvals, baselines, and traceability evidence for engineering CM (not a certification claim).

cta.heading: Want Something Like This for Your Business?
cta.body: Tell us what you need — we’ll scope a custom app or adapt one of these patterns to your workflow.
